paragraphs.en: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
paragraphs.zh: OpenShell 是面向自主 AI 智能体的安全、私密的运行时环境。

paragraphs.en: New in OpenShell 0.1.x: a stable release cadence, new isolation primitives, an expanded extension surface, and new APIs. Read the 0.1.0 upgrade guide .
paragraphs.zh: OpenShell 0.1.x 新增内容：稳定的发布节奏、新的隔离原语、扩展的扩展接口以及新的 API。 请阅读 0.1.0 升级指南。

sents.en: New in OpenShell 0.1.x: a stable release cadence, new isolation primitives, an expanded extension surface, and new APIs.
sents.zh: OpenShell 0.1.x 新增内容：稳定的发布节奏、新的隔离原语、扩展的扩展接口以及新的 API。

sents.en: Read the 0.1.0 upgrade guide .
sents.zh: 请阅读 0.1.0 升级指南。

paragraphs.en: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents. Agents are most useful when they can read files, install packages, call APIs, and use credentials. OpenShell gives them that capability without giving them unrestricted access to your data, secrets, or network. You declare what each agent can touch in a policy, and OpenShell enforces it.
paragraphs.zh: OpenShell 是面向自主 AI 智能体机群的安全、私密的运行时。 智能体在能够读取文件、安装软件包、调用 API 以及使用凭证时才能发挥最大效用。 OpenShell 赋予智能体这些能力，同时不会让它们不受限制地访问你的数据、机密或网络。 你在策略中声明每个智能体可以触碰的内容，OpenShell 负责强制执行。

sents.en: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents.
sents.zh: OpenShell 是面向自主 AI 智能体机群的安全、私密的运行时。

sents.en: Agents are most useful when they can read files, install packages, call APIs, and use credentials.
sents.zh: 智能体在能够读取文件、安装软件包、调用 API 以及使用凭证时才能发挥最大效用。

sents.en: OpenShell gives them that capability without giving them unrestricted access to your data, secrets, or network.
sents.zh: OpenShell 赋予智能体这些能力，同时不会让它们不受限制地访问你的数据、机密或网络。

sents.en: You declare what each agent can touch in a policy, and OpenShell enforces it.
sents.zh: 你在策略中声明每个智能体可以触碰的内容，OpenShell 负责强制执行。

paragraphs.en: OpenShell governs what agents can do in two ways: it instruments the kernel to enforce policy on every file access, system call, and network connection at runtime, and it uses formal verification to check what a policy change would allow before it is applied.
paragraphs.zh: OpenShell 通过两种方式约束智能体能做什么：它对内核进行插桩，以便在运行时对每次文件访问、系统调用和网络连接执行策略；并且它使用形式化验证，在策略变更被应用之前检查该变更将允许什么。

paragraphs.en: See Architecture for how the gateway, supervisor, and sandbox fit together.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅「架构」部分了解网关、监督者和沙箱如何协同工作。

paragraphs.en: You need Linux, macOS on Apple Silicon, or Windows with WSL 2 (experimental), plus Docker, Podman, or host virtualization. See the Support Matrix for details.
paragraphs.zh: 您需要 Linux、Apple Silicon 上的 macOS，或 Windows 搭配 WSL 2（实验性），另外还需要 Docker、Podman 或主机虚拟化。 详情请参阅支持矩阵。

sents.zh: 您需要 Linux、Apple Silicon 上的 macOS，或 Windows 搭配 WSL 2（实验性），另外还需要 Docker、Podman 或主机虚拟化。

sents.en: See the Support Matrix for details.
sents.zh: 详情请参阅支持矩阵。

paragraphs.en: curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/main/install.sh | sh openshell sandbox create --name demo The installer sets up the CLI and a local gateway. The default sandbox image is minimal Ubuntu with no agent installed. To run a real agent, follow Run Your First Agent : it runs OpenCode against a free OpenRouter model and shows how to approve new access as the agent needs it.
paragraphs.zh: curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/main/install.sh | sh openshell sandbox create --name demo 安装程序会设置 CLI 和一个本地网关。 默认的沙箱镜像是一个极简的 Ubuntu，没有安装任何智能体。 要运行一个真实的智能体，请参阅 Run Your First Agent：它使用 OpenCode 对接一个免费的 OpenRouter 模型，并展示如何在智能体需要时批准新的访问权限。

sents.zh: curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/main/install.sh | sh openshell sandbox create --name demo 安装程序会设置 CLI 和一个本地网关。

sents.en: The default sandbox image is minimal Ubuntu with no agent installed.
sents.zh: 默认的沙箱镜像是一个极简的 Ubuntu，没有安装任何智能体。

sents.en: To run a real agent, follow Run Your First Agent : it runs OpenCode against a free OpenRouter model and shows how to approve new access as the agent needs it.
sents.zh: 要运行一个真实的智能体，请参阅 Run Your First Agent：它使用 OpenCode 对接一个免费的 OpenRouter 模型，并展示如何在智能体需要时批准新的访问权限。

paragraphs.en: Install the public OpenShell skills for your coding agent:
paragraphs.zh: 为你的编码智能体安装公开的 OpenShell 技能：

paragraphs.en: npx skills add NVIDIA/OpenShell The skills teach your agent to drive the OpenShell CLI, write sandbox policies, and debug gateways and inference routing. They live in skills/ and work without an OpenShell source checkout.
paragraphs.zh: npx skills add NVIDIA/OpenShell 这些技能教会你的智能体驱动 OpenShell CLI、编写沙箱策略，以及调试网关和推理路由。 它们位于 skills/ 目录中，无需检出 OpenShell 源码即可使用。

sents.en: npx skills add NVIDIA/OpenShell The skills teach your agent to drive the OpenShell CLI, write sandbox policies, and debug gateways and inference routing.

sents.en: They live in skills/ and work without an OpenShell source checkout.
sents.zh: 它们位于 skills/ 目录中，无需检出 OpenShell 源码即可使用。

paragraphs.en: SDKs connect applications to an OpenShell gateway. They do not install the CLI. Use the same OpenShell release for the SDK and the gateway when possible.
paragraphs.zh: SDK 将应用程序连接到 OpenShell 网关。 它们不会安装 CLI。 尽可能为 SDK 和网关使用相同版本的 OpenShell 发行版。

sents.en: SDKs connect applications to an OpenShell gateway.
sents.zh: SDK 将应用程序连接到 OpenShell 网关。

sents.en: They do not install the CLI.
sents.zh: 它们不会安装 CLI。

sents.en: Use the same OpenShell release for the SDK and the gateway when possible.
sents.zh: 尽可能为 SDK 和网关使用相同版本的 OpenShell 发行版。

paragraphs.en: OpenShell is built agent-first: it is developed with the same agent-driven workflows it enables. See CONTRIBUTING.md for development setup and the contribution workflow, and AGENTS.md for repository coding conventions.
paragraphs.zh: OpenShell 以智能体优先的方式构建：它本身就是用其所支持的同类智能体驱动工作流开发的。 开发环境搭建与贡献工作流请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md，代码库编码规范请参阅 AGENTS.md。

paragraphs.en: OpenShell collects anonymous telemetry, limited to operational categories and counts, to help improve the project. It does not collect sandbox names, hostnames, file paths, prompts, credentials, provider or model names, or user content. To disable it, set OPENSHELL_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false on the gateway, or server.telemetryEnabled=false for Helm installs. You can also compile telemetry out entirely. See Telemetry for details and the community telemetry reports for published usage trends.
paragraphs.zh: OpenShell 收集匿名遥测数据，仅限于运行类别和数量，以帮助改进项目。 它不会收集沙盒名称、主机名、文件路径、提示词、凭据、提供商或模型名称，也不会收集用户内容。 要禁用它，请在网关上设置 OPENSHELL_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false，对于 Helm 安装则设置 server.telemetryEnabled=false。 你也可以在编译时完全移除遥测功能。 详情请参阅遥测文档，已发布的用量趋势请参阅社区遥测报告。
